items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I was just a sub for Sammy, it was only ten days with Duke, I subbed for Sammy.

ctx.x: Oh, my the list goes on and on. You played with Ellington, and —
I was just a sub for Sammy, it was only ten days with Duke, I subbed for Sammy.
Now you made a comment that you felt you didn’t play good with Ellington ‘cause you were listening too hard.
